description: Record a review that was held: its notes, its decisions as the participants stated them, the matrix elements it discussed, and the date it was held if not today. The agent records what the committee decided; it never decides in its place, so write decisions only from what people said or wrote. A review is recorded once (MEETING_ALREADY_COMPLETED after that). The reviews to record are listed by get_agenda (kind review_unrecorded). Recording it keeps a snapshot of the matrix as it stands at that moment (values, progress, health of the initiatives, latest readings, score): record it right after the meeting, before correcting figures, so the snapshot is what the committee saw. get_review reads it back.

decisions.description: One entry per decision, as stated by the participants (at most 50)

discussed_element_ids.description: UUIDs of the matrix elements discussed

held_on.description: Date the review was held, YYYY-MM-DD, if not today. Never in the future.

notes.description: What was said: progress, blockers, discussion

review_id.description: UUID of the review, from get_agenda (required)

name: record_review
title: Record a review
